claim: Courts first determine whether there is an "otherwise enforceable agreement," then whether the covenant is "ancillary to or part of" that agreement.
excerpt: The New Test. Under the Court's new holding, a covenant not to compete that meets the reasonableness requirements set forth in the statute "becomes enforceable when the employer performs the promises it made in exchange for the covenant." Thus, noncompete contracts with at-will employees and noncompete contracts that are entered into after employment begins will be easier to enforce.
